metadata.value: This is my work directory of our submission to Machine Learning Journal. The work is based on the Vertex-Enrichment process of Graph Neural Networks. That is: augmenting the node features with relational-features obtained by using symbolic domain-knowledge. We treat these symbolic relations as hyperedges meaning any relation or a relational feature is a hyperedge. For more information on this, please go through our paper.
